name: Chosun Ilbo TikTok Card News
summary: Turn a news article, pasted text or a project video into an editable 4:5 card news Draft in Chosun Ilbo templates, then export each card as an image.

compatibility.selects: Requires Panel SDK runScript/runShell/askAI, Draft setFrameSize, setClipTransform and addMotionGraphic, Project createFolder and moveToFolder, and the panel runtime services FileSystem and MediaGeneration. Checked on Selects 2.0.580 on macOS.
